stories.title: New NHS accountability framework unveiled by Wales’ Health Minister
stories.summary: Problems in the Welsh NHS will be spotted and addressed before they become serious issues, Wales’ health minister has said. Mabon ap Gwynfor updated Senedd Members today (September 29) on a review of the effectiveness of NHS Wales’ current system – the ‘Escalation and Intervention Framework’. stories.title: North Wales Police detective resigns and admits sexual offence involving two girls
stories.summary: A former North Wales Police detective has admitted recording an image beneath clothing without consent in an incident involving two girls in Old Colwyn. stories.title: Price cap rises to £1,723 as forecasters predict near £2,000 bills from January
stories.summary: Energy bills for households on standard tariffs will rise by 4 per cent from Thursday, with a further increase of about 16 per cent forecast for January. stories.title: North Wales Coast line to close through Flint and Shotton for three weeks in January
stories.summary: Trains through Flint and Shotton Low Level will stop for three weeks in January while Network Rail carries out more than £25 million of work on the North Wales Coast line. stories.title: North Wales health board says two-year waiting lists ‘almost zero’ by next April
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board says by April 2027 there will be almost no patients waiting two years or more for treatment in North Wales.
